realm_screening_audit.mapping_basis: deterministic signal-type to realm crosswalk for screening triage; conceptual overlap remains and requires exact-span validation
realm_screening_audit.robustness_boundary: realm assignment is deterministic screening triage with allowed multi-realm overlap; it is not a validated exclusive coding frame
realm_screening_audit.status: multi-label screening; fractional weights prevent double count

screening_feature_boundary.performative_stage_conclusion: not computable until exact text spans and two-coder decisions exist
screening_feature_boundary.screening_scope_policy: screening accepts retained title/subject_terms/abstract/full_text surfaces; all_title_level is only a corpus-condition flag for the current run

sector_axis_independence.interpretation_boundary: association describes the acquired/classified corpus and is confounded by retrieval/classification design; it is not workforce prevalence or causal sector demand
sector_axis_independence.permutation_interpretation: small p-values indicate non-random corpus structure under the curated design, not external prevalence or causal demand effects
sector_axis_independence.permutation_method: 50,000 unrestricted axis-label permutations with fixed sector labels and fixed axis margins
sector_axis_independence.unit_independence_note: deduplicated evidence IDs avoid duplicated demand rows, but this curated corpus is not an iid sample and may retain correlated screening context
